_about: Pick for my machine (shared/forge_machine.py, Relay task 323, 2026-10-24). The visual levels and power choices it can pick, lightest first, and the settings each one sets. "forge" keys are the hub's own, "desktop" keys are Forge Desktop's (the desktop extension on Linux, Windows and macOS), "both" are shared by the two (the frame rate caps and battery twins apply to the hub and the desktop alike). Adding a level or a choice is one entry here; a key must be a forge_theme setting. gpu and cpu classes are matched in order against the names the machine reports (case-insensitive regular expressions); the first match wins.

visual.label: Light
visual.about: Few, slow particles, no blur, no shadows, nothing drawn behind an open app.

visual.label: Balanced
visual.about: Forge's defaults: particles at 30 frames a second, blur and shadows on.

visual.label: Rich
visual.about: More particles at 45 frames a second, blur kept on, the visualiser behind apps too.

visual.label: Full
visual.about: Everything at 60 frames a second, twice the particles, the desktop never rests.

power.label: Saver
power.about: Least power: 30 frames a second at most, 20 on battery, lighter video, the saver from 40% battery.

power.label: Balanced
power.about: Forge's defaults: full rate on the charger, half on battery, the saver from 20%.

power.label: Performance
power.about: Full rate on battery too, the visualiser kept on, the saver only from 10%.

gpu_classes.label: a recent built-in GPU
gpu_classes.match: iris xe|arc graphics|arc\(tm\) graphics|radeon [0-9]{3}m|radeon 8[0-9]{2}s|apple m[0-9]|apple|phoenix|hawk point|rembrandt|strix|krackan|meteor lake|arrow lake|lunar lake|panther lake

gpu_classes.label: an older built-in GPU
gpu_classes.match: uhd graphics|hd graphics|iris plus|iris pro|vega|radeon graphics|radeon\(tm\) graphics|mali|adreno|llvmpipe|software

rules._about: Steps after the GPU class: a high-power chip lifts a recent built-in GPU one level (it gets more watts); little memory or few threads drop one level. Power: a machine with no battery starts on performance, a laptop on balanced; on battery now, or a sustained CPU limit at or under low_watts, steps one down.

_about_cpu_gpu: When no GPU name matches a class, the CPU's name is tried too (an AMD chip says 'w/ Radeon 780M Graphics').
